command: taskset -c 8-25 iverilog -g2012 -s tb_aha_garnet_microsequencer -o work/results/l2_aha_microsequencer.vvp rtl/integration/aha_garnet_axi_config_loader.sv rtl/integration/aha_garnet_proc_packet_writer.sv rtl/integration/aha_garnet_microsequencer.sv tb/tb_aha_garnet_microsequencer.sv && taskset -c 8-25 vvp work/results/l2_aha_microsequencer.vvp
success_condition: An already-lowered Gaussian control transcript executes packet write, AXI configuration, and interrupt wait in order through one sequencer, without direct nested-Interconnect driving.
failure_policy: If ordering fails, locate the first sub-operation against ProcDriver/AxilDriver/Env_cgra_configure; do not synthesize a completion event before the official Garnet interrupt.
